description: This file defines the LogWrapper class which implements the LogNode interface, providing a wrapper around Android's native Log utility to facilitate logging with optional chaining to another LogNode.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A helper class that wraps Android's native Log utility, implementing the LogNode interface to enable chained logging and facilitate output to multiple targets.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the linked list chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode that will receive log data after this node.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs a message with a specific priority, tag, message, and optional throwable; then forwards the log to the next node if present.
